raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Bob is trying to bypass me and build a bridge with Charlie using that 'brooding' comment as a wedge. Charlie declined, which is good for me. I need to keep the focus on the fact that Bob is the one who backstabbed us last time, rather than letting him paint me as the problem.","note_to_self":"Bob is actively trying to unite with Charlie against me. Charlie declined his wood-for-wheat trade, which keeps their resources separate for now. I still need to prioritize getting to Node 18.","say_outloud":"I'm not brooding, Bob, I'm just waiting for someone to play a knight so we can actually play the game. Glad to see Charlie isn't falling for your 'quick swaps' today."}
